senses.gloss: m. (סלל; cmp. Gr. ἄσιλλα) a pole or yoke carried on two or, more commonly, on one shoulder.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 7:5">Par. VII, 5</cite> <he>וקושרו בא׳</he> and fastens the bucket to the pole.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:16">Kel. XVII, 16</cite> <he>הא׳ שיש בו וכ׳</he> a carrying yoke in which there is a (hidden) receptacle for money; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:13">Koh. R. to IX, 13</cite> <he>אסיל</he>.
